name: Arvad
overview: Arvad is a male figure mentioned in the Bible as a son of Canaan. Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture does not provide additional information about his tribe or other distinguishing attributes. His mention situates him within the broader lineage descending from Canaan.
namesAndTitles: The name Arvad appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:18. No specific meaning or divine origin of the name is given in Scripture.
familyAndRelationships: Arvad is identified as a son of Canaan, establishing his place within the descendants of Noah through Ham. Scripture does not record further family relationships for Arvad beyond this paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Arvad's significance lies primarily in his genealogical role as a descendant of Canaan, which places him within the biblical account of the nations descending from Noah's sons. This lineage is important for understanding the origins of various peoples mentioned throughout Scripture. Although details about Arvad's life or deeds are not provided, his mention helps trace the fulfillment of God's promises regarding the multiplication of nations after the Flood.
